announcements.text: American Roll-On Roll-Off Carrier LLC, Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida (HTC71126DE138); Farrell Lines Inc., Norfolk, Virginia (HTC71126DE139); Federated Maritime LLC, Boca Raton, Florida (HTC71126DE140); Liberty Global Logistics LLC, Jericho, New York (HTC71126DE141); Patriot Shipping LLC, New Orleans, Louisiana (HTC71126DE142); Schuyler Line Navigation Co. LLC, West Palm Beach, Florida (HTC71126DE143); and Waterman Transport Inc., Mobile, Alabama (HTC71126DE144), have been awarded an indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, fixed-price, multiple award contract with an estimated program face value of $1,200,000,000, bringing the estimated total cumulative face value of the program to $1,200,000,000 (with a cumulative maximum ceiling value of $2,700,000,000). This contract is for global, short-term dry cargo time and voyage charter services using roll-on/roll-off, multi-purpose, or vehicle carrier vessels to support U.S. Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM) strategic sealift missions. The base period of performance is from Sept. 1, 2026, to Aug. 31, 2031. The funding is fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030 transportation working capital funds. USTRANSCOM, Directorate of Acquisition, Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Aptim Federal Services LLC, Baton Rouge, Louisiana (N39430-26D-2001); Bristol Engineering Services Co. LLC,* Anchorage, Alaska (N3943026-D-2002); CMS Corp., Bargersville, Indiana (N39430-26-D-2003); Dawson Technical Inc.,* San Antonio, TX (N39430-26-D-2004); Environmental Chemical Corp., Burlingame, California (N39430-26-D-2005); Pacific Design Builders LLC,* Tamuning, Guam (N39430-26-D-2006); PCI Bhate JV LLC,* Atmore, Alabama (N39430-26-D-2007); Tepa & Pond Constructors JV,* Kansas City, Missouri (N39430-26-D-2008); Weston Solutions Inc., West Chester, Pennsylvania (N39430-26-D-2009); and WSP USA Government Solutions Inc., New York, New York (N39430-26-D-2010), are awarded a combined $997,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award construction contract for construction, maintenance, repair, and engineering services for pipelines, fuel storage tanks, and associated petroleum oil lubricant facilities and equipment. Work will be performed at Navy and Marine Corps locations outside the continental U.S. (50%); and inside the continental U.S. (50%), and is expected to be complete by August 2031. The maximum dollar value, including the base period of five years, for all 10 contracts is $997,000,000. Fiscal 2026 (Navy) working capital funds in the amount of $10,000 for each awardee; and a seed task order in the amount of $587,438, will be obligated at time of award to satisfy the minimum guarantee. Funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured via the SAM.gov website, with 17 offers received. Naval Facilities Engineering and Expeditionary Warfare Center, Port Hueneme, California, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Booz Allen Hamilton Inc., McLean, Virginia (M9549425D5001 P00005); Concurrent Technologies Corp., Johnstown, Pennsylvania (M9549425D5002 P00005); and KPMG LLP, McLean, Virginia (M9549425D5003 P00004), are each awarded a modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple-award contract. The modifications increase the shared maximum ordering value by a combined $96,718,238, resulting in an estimated aggregate ceiling of $198,145,615 for all contracts, with the companies having an opportunity to compete for individual task orders. The contracts provide professional support services in support of Marine Corps Installations Command Headquarters. Work will be performed at contractor facilities (50%); the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia (25%); Naval Support Facility, Arlington, Virginia (15%); other government facilities within the contiguous U.S (8%); and government facilities outside the contiguous U.S., including Hawaii and Guam (2%). The ordering period ends Nov. 5, 2029. No funds will be obligated at the time of award. Funds will be obligated on individual task orders as they are issued. This modification was not competitively procured pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1), Only One Responsible Source or a Limited Number of Responsible Sources. The Marine Corps Installations Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity. Corvid Technologies LLC, Mooresville, North Carolina, is awarded a $33,856,428, firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, and cost reimbursement, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide a weapon sled assembly for the Navy/Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System. Work will be performed in Mooresville, North Carolina, and is expected to be complete by August 2034. No funds will be obligated at time of award. Funds will be obligated on individual task orders and individual delivery orders as they are issued. This contract was not competitively procured pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. The Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps, Quantico, Virginia, is the contracting activity (M67854-26-D-1008). Riptide Technology Inc., Alexandria, Virginia, is being awarded a $27,736,469 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (NRL) research and development in support of Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (C4ISR) for optimized, integrated operational space and ground systems. This contract includes options which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of this contract to $148,293,255. Work will be performed at the NRL, Washington, D.C., and is expected to be completed by August 2031. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) in the amount of $2,505,749 will be obligated at the time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured as a small business set-aside with five offers received via Contract Opportunities on SAM.gov. NRL, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N0017326C2426).

announcements.text: Epsilon C5I Inc.,* San Diego, California, is awarded a $9,327,502 cost-plus-fixed-fee order (N6893626F5320) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N6893621G0003). This order provides for the continued expansion, evolution, implementation, and furnishing of VISION technology, a full-motion video, multi-intelligence analysis capability that produces analytic capacity by leveraging multi-source intelligence to accelerate the find, fix, track, target, engage, and assess process in support of Small Business Innovation Research Phase III topic N101-100, Multi-Source Imagery and Geopositional Exploitation in support of the Navy. Work will be performed in San Diego, California, and is expected to be completed in February 2027. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Defense Wide) funds in the amount of $4,655,199; and fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $4,519,125, will be obligated at the time of award; $4,655,199 of which will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competed. Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division, China Lake, California, is the contracting activity.
